next.pattern: One regular Council Meeting a month, usually the second Wednesday, split into a 10:00 a.m. morning session and a 6:00 p.m. evening session (public hearings and second readings are in the evening). Doral Government Center Council Chambers, 8401 NW 53 Terrace. The charter requires at least 11 regular monthly meetings a year (Sec. 4.01(a)); no meeting was held in July 2026. Local Planning Agency meets at 5:30 p.m. the same day when there are zoning items.

levers.how: Each regular meeting has a Public Comments item near the start of the morning session (item 5) and again at the start of the evening session (item 18). The charter's Citizens' Bill of Rights A(5) gives any interested person the right to appear before the Council, subject to reasonable time limits.
levers.rules: No time limit, sign-up method or speaker rules are posted in the agenda, the meeting notice or the clerk's pages; the charter says reasonable time limits may be imposed. Lobbyists must register with the City Clerk first (Resolution 2007-31 and County Code Sec. 2-11.1(s)).
levers.deadline: Attend the meeting; comments are taken at the Public Comments item of each session
